      Privacy, offline use, and accessibility

      Application content and backups are processed in your browser. The app requests its own static files and checks for updates. It has no app accounts, analytics, or text-upload service. On the public demo, Sites hosts the static files and can receive ordinary request metadata such as your IP address. Host-provided security scripts also run on the public demo. Do not enter real application or sensitive information. Browser extensions, browser sync, and operating-system assistance are outside its control.

      Saved work uses local browser storage. Form drafts and interrupted-save recovery use this tab’s session storage, which can disappear when the tab closes. These are not encrypted or separate backups. Use JSON export for saved work; save or copy unsubmitted forms separately.

      Offline support works only after setup succeeds for this browser and address. App updates wait for your choice and will not reload while workspace saving is unresolved. Use one editing tab and keep backups outside browser storage.

      Use Tab and Shift+Tab to move, Enter or Space for buttons and disclosures, and Shift+arrow keys to select text. Full checklist and one-step views retain the same controls. Text status accompanies color. Automated and manual checks cover selected flows; full WCAG conformance is not claimed.

      View the earlier scripted change-review example. The workspace now records dependencies and propagates separate source-change and reported-work-change review reasons.

      Preparation stays in your hands. StepTrace does not decide eligibility, guarantee completeness, or submit applications.
